acceptance_rule: If token rate <=4.4 or any gate fails, record as rejected and do not modify source. If >4.4, record as diagnostic only and require source integration plus clean pushed-source reproduction before SOTA promotion.

hard_bound: This can only improve CPU fallback source layout; it cannot reduce CPU fallback math/synchronization. Prior same-mechanism top128/top256 pack-mmap controls reached only 4.1/4.0 tok/s. Accept no result without eval_tok_s > 4.4, TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms, RAM <=16GB including page cache, no OOM/swap, and coherent France output.
